full_judgment: 6. The revisional court came to the conclusion that the judgment of the court of appeal below was not a proper judgment of reversal inasmuch as the said court did not advert to the findings of fact arrived at by the trial court. The error of law committed by the appellate court had resulted in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. Accordingly the said Court set aside the decree of the appellate court and restored that of the trial court.
